representation.name: ENCODE ATAC 2.2.3 repository probe
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
{
  echo 'top level:'
  find /software/atac-seq-pipeline -maxdepth 2 -type f | sed 's#^#/##' | sort | head -250
  echo 'executables:'
  find /software/atac-seq-pipeline /software -maxdepth 3 -type f -perm -111 2>/dev/null | sed 's#^#/##' | sort | head -250
  echo 'python modules:'
  python3 - <<'PY'
mods=['caper','cromwell','croo','qc2tsv']
for m in mods:
    try:
        mod=__import__(m)
        print(m, getattr(mod,'__file__',None))
    except Exception as e:
        print(m, 'ERR', type(e).__name__, str(e))
PY
} > repo_probe.txt
